title: Tax by rate
caption: His accountant asks how much tax his bills charged last quarter. Prakash has the answer. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz, Bills and GST sets how an owner's bills are numbered, whether and at what rate GST shows on them, and shows the tax his bills charged by rate for any period. It shows tax collected on his bills only; it does not file returns.
